Title: Azure Data Factory is now available in two additional regions

Body.Content:
Azure Data Factory is now available in two new regions:

  • China North 2 
  • South India 

You can now provision Data Factory, Azure Integration Runtime, and SQL Server Integration Service (SSIS) Integration Runtime in these new regions in order to co-locate your Extract-Transform-Load logic with your data lake and compute.  You can also use these regions for BCDR (Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery) purposes in case you need to failover from another region within the geo.

Refer to this page for the full set of Azure Data Factory supported regions.
